vocab.meaning: Clickable action trigger, incl. floating action buttons and morphing triggers (Button, Action Morph, Orbit Menu)
Any control that takes a value: text, code, slider, select, switch, ruler (OTP Input, Combobox, Instrument Form)
Popover/dropdown/command list of actions or options (Command Menu, Glass Menu, Profile Menu, Filter Menu)
Moving between places: navbars, tab bars, docks, rails, mega menus (Dock, Morph Nav, Liquid Tab Bar)
Overlay that interrupts or focuses: modal, sheet, popover panel (Sheet Stack, Share Sheet, Permission Request)
Transient or stacked system messages: toast, alert, badge (Toaster, Notification Stack)
Rows and columns of records: grid, spreadsheet, spec table (Data Grid, Spec Table)
Quantitative visualisation: bar, line, area, radar, sankey, treemap, funnel, candlestick
Grouped fields with validation and a save bar (Instrument Form, Email Draft, Prompt Studio variables)
Plans, tiers, quotas and pay-for-usage sections (Instrument Pricing, Usage Meter)
Top-of-page headline section with a showpiece visual (Instrument Hero, Ink Fluid, Sand Text)
Waiting states: spinner, skeleton, shimmer, working pill (Thinking Loader, Shimmer Loader)
Nothing-here-yet illustrations and messages (Empty Calendar, Ghosted Chat, Glass Folder)
First-run guidance, steppers, tips, how-it-works steps (Tips Panel, Step Cards, Pipeline Steps, Team Invite)
Switching between views in place: segmented controls, tab bars (Segmented Control, Glass Segmented)
Self-contained content tile (Glass Card, Holo Card, Tilt Card, Dither Cards, Wallet Stack)
Choosing a date, time, model or option from a set (Date Reel, Time Dial, Model Picker)
Bringing files in: drop zone, attachments, progress per file (Dropzone)
Finding things: command palette, combobox filter, query box
Trust signals on marketing pages: logos, testimonials, reviews (Logo Marquee, Testimonial Wall, Logo Cluster)
Animated type: reveal, ticker, slot reels, gradient or sand text (Text Reveal, Slot Text, Number Ticker)
Ambient layer behind content (Dither Field, Grid Background, Gradient Floor, Ink Fluid)
Explanatory illustration of a system or process, not a data plot (Prompt Cache, Vector Search, Layer Stack)
Audio, video, image and player UI (Now Playing, Voice Recorder, Cover Flow, Dither Image)
Kanban or lane layout of items by status or owner (Agent Inbox, Agent Lanes, Task Tracker)
Threads, replies, mentions and discussion (Comment Thread, Reaction Bar)
How far along something is: bars, rings, steps, ETA (Progress Tracker, Activity Rings, Usage Meter)
User response to output: thumbs, reactions, retry, share (Message Actions, Reaction Bar)
Conversational assistant UI: messages, composer, replies (AI Chat, Chat Composer, AI Answer)
Output that arrives token by token or as a live feed (AI Answer, Token Scope, Realtime Stream)
Autonomous AI doing multi-step work: plans, runs, steering, tasks
Several agents or sub-agents coordinated: orchestrator, lanes, tree, team (Agent Orchestrator, Agent Tree, Agent Team)
Human-in-the-loop gate: approve, deny, always allow, decisions (Approval Card, Agent Approvals, Decision Inbox)
Citations and provenance tying claims to evidence (Provenance Trail, Research Desk, AI Answer)
Visible thinking: thought steps, tree search, working panels (Thinking State, Reasoning Tree)
A model invoking a tool or MCP server with args and result (Tool Call Card, MCP Servers)
What an assistant remembers: notes, forget, pause (Memory Panel, Agent Memory)
Context window contents, compaction and prompt caching (Context Window, Prompt Cache)
Tokens, credits, spend, budgets and forecasts for AI usage (Usage Forecast, Usage Meter, Model Picker bars)
Testing model or prompt quality: suites, baselines, regressions, arenas (Eval Suite, Eval Lab, Model Arena)
Speech input/output and audio presence (Voice Orb, Voice Recorder, dictation)
Prompt authoring and composition: composer, templates, variables (Prompt Studio, AI Composer)
Choosing or comparing LLMs and their internals (Model Picker, Model Wheel, Mixture of Experts, Speculative Decoding)
RAG, embeddings, indexing and extraction from documents (Knowledge Base, Vector Search, Document Extract)
Tracing and inspecting runs: waterfalls, scrubbers, telemetry (Trace Waterfall, Run Scrubber, Telemetry Board)
Pointer dragging, flinging, throwing, reordering
Behaviour that responds to pointer hover: lift, reveal, magnify
Scroll-driven or auto-scrolling content: marquees, wheels, virtual lists
Shortcuts, key navigation, typing visuals (Command Menu, Keycap Keyboard, Glow Keyboard)
Touch and pointer gestures: swipe, flick, pull-down, long-press, peel
On/off and mode switches, expandable or foldable states
One surface or value smoothly becoming another (Action Morph, Morph Nav, Dot Matrix Number, Blur Crossfade)
Elements that track or react to the cursor: tilt, gravity, magnify (Tilt Card, Gravity Well, Holo Card)
Dragging a playhead or timeline to move through time (Run Scrubber, Race Bar Chart, Cover Flow)
Frosted, refractive, liquid-glass surfaces (Glass Menu, Glass Tab Bar, Control Center)
Ordered-dither, halftone, ASCII dot art (Dither Field, Dither Image, Dither Cards, Confidence Dither)
Real depth and perspective: tilt, covers, wheels, globes, keycaps
Many small moving dots or grains: galaxies, sand, stars, sims
Paper, stickers, folds, pages and print metaphors (Page Curl, Sticker Peel)
Springs, gravity, inertia, collisions and rubber-banding (Dock, Gravity Well, Black Hole)
Colour gradients, aurora and glow washes (Gradient Floor, Gradient Text, aurora backdrops)
Liquid, ink and flowing-sim looks (Ink Fluid, Liquid Tab Bar, Streamgraph)
Light emission, bloom, holographic foil and illuminated parts (Glow Cloud, Glow Keyboard, Holo Card)
Public product page sections: hero, logos, pricing, features
Overview pages of KPIs, charts and tables (Dashboard, Mission Control, Finance)
Configuration and preferences UI (Control Center, Autonomy Dial, Instrument Form, Profile Menu)
The frame around an app: rail, header, breadcrumb, search (Instrument Shell, Morph Nav)
Pieces made for selling or showing off: showpieces, hero art, illustrations
A whole composed product screen rather than one component (the Screens group)
Headline numbers with deltas and sparklines (Readout Bar, Activity Rings, Number Ticker)
Things over time or on a time axis (Agent Timeline, Trace Waterfall, Race Bar Chart)
Geographic or spatial layouts: globes, regions, time zones (Revenue Globe, Time Dial)
Nodes and edges: networks, trees, agent graphs (Agent Graph, Agent Tree, Reasoning Tree)
Money, markets, payments, accounting and revenue (Market Terminal, Accounting, MRR Waterfall, Payment Flow)
Quantities or events moving between stages: sankey, funnel, pipeline (Sankey Flow, Journey Flow, Data Flow)
Nested part-to-whole structure: treemap, sunburst, tree
Ordered leaderboards and comparisons (Race Bar Chart, Model Arena, Eval Lab)
Projections, bands and what-if scenarios (Usage Forecast, Finance runway)
Live-updating data feeds and counters (Realtime Stream, Token Scope, Market Terminal)
